A '''cultural center''' was located in [[Montrol City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gandle Ott]]. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the center staged an exhibition of [[ganther dance]]s for the crew of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]''.
